remarks: Nestled in a quiet and serene neighborhood of West Norwalk, this charming 3 bedroom 3 bathroom home is a blend of modern style with comfort. With natural light and open space concept that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere, you will fall in love.   The home features brand new kitchen with quartz countertop, large kitchen island, bar area, and plenty of storage for all your family needs. The master bedroom is a true sanctuary, featuring a private bathroom, and a spacious walk in closet providing a retreat within the home for relation and comfort. The two additional bedrooms are very generous and provide additional room and storage  Outside, the generous yard wraps around the house offering plenty of space for kids to play and hoisting memorable parties with friends and family. The front yard creates a welcoming entryway while the backyard provides a private retreat for outdoor fun and relaxation
